links.outcome: Factual accuracy and guideline concordance of LLM pertussis answers against Chinese guidelines
links.effect: No harmful advice or direct guideline contradictions were identified in any model output; ChatGPT achieved the highest mean accuracy/concordance score.
links.quote: No harmful advice or direct guideline contradictions were identified in any model output.

links.outcome: Understandability and actionability (C-PEMAT) and quality (GQS) of LLM patient education content
links.effect: Median C-PEMAT generally acceptable across models; ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Doubao scored significantly higher than Wenxin Yiyan and Gemini on C-PEMAT and GQS (p<0.001).
links.quote: Median C-PEMAT scores across all models suggested generally acceptable accessibility for patient education.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of LLM-generated patient education materials for pertussis using standardized readability and quality rubrics, without testing a specific deployment guardrail or practice.
